headline: Playtika Surges After Board Decides to Remain Independent Public Company
summary: Playtika shares surged after the mobile gaming app company's board announced it will continue operating as an independent publicly traded company following a review of strategic alternatives.
why: Decisions to terminate buyout explorations or remain independent remove takeover speculation while establishing a standalone operational roadmap for public shareholders.

impacts.name: Playtika Holding
impacts.why: Concluding a strategic review in favor of independence clarified the company's future corporate structure.
